title.narrative: Providing an Education of Quality in Haiti (PEQH)

description.narrative: The objectives of the Project are to: (i) strengthen public management of the education sector; (ii) improve learning conditions inselected public and non-public primary schools; and (iii) support enrollment of students in selected public and non-public primary schools.
